programme.title: Oversteer
programme.desc: Feng defies his father and leaves home to pursue his dream of becoming an auto mechanic. Along the way, he unexpectedly finds himself drawn into the thrilling world of car racing.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: After a jewelry store heist, the young thieves left behind a graffiti tag that reads 'FRANK', sparking public curiosity about their motives. What message are they trying to convey?

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: Triad
programme.desc: Set in the 90's during the Hong Kong handover, this drama depicts how a bookworm rises to become a formidable leader in the triads.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his son's failed marriage and Kwai's dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: A simple Chinese immigrant wages a perilous war against one of the most powerful criminal organizations on the planet, in this sprawling action drama.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.

programme.title: In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: Based on a true event of a news investigative unit receiving a tip-off about abuse in a care home for elderly and disabled. Reporter Kay goes undercover to unveil the cruel truth in broad daylight.

programme.title: Back To The Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lived in seclusion for 20 years until a time traveller returned to rewrite history, forcing them to defend the Qin dynasty and fate itself.

programme.title: Vital Signs
programme.desc: Paramedic Wang partners with Ma after being assigned to a new station. Though he clashes with Ma's unconventional methods, Wang soon rediscovers the true mission of a paramedic - saving every life.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: Winner of 9 awards at the 32nd Hong Kong Film Awards! When a police van is hijacked, Deputy Commissioner M.B Lee launches a rescue operation codenamed Cold War.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: When a school bus driver is injured after risking his life to save a boy during an accident, the boy's father invites him to live with them. However, disturbing facts soon begin to emerge.

programme.title: Last Song For You
programme.desc: Musician Su reunites with his first love Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journey—her parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: Moscow Mission
programme.desc: A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman takes charge of an operation to arrest the criminals who perform a heist on the train, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead...

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: When the reluctant son of a gangster is summoned home to avenge his father's death, he enlists his father's always-drunk bodyguard to help him out.

programme.title: To Live And Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: Disoriented and trapped in notorious, vice-ridden Mongkok, a once-feared triad figure struggles to adapt to life in the wake of his 30-year prison sentence.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Celebrity Peng travels to Rome for the shooting of a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Man Man, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Jackie Chan gets transported to the past as he goes after a valuable treasure. He now has to experience his past life, while searching for his way back to the present life.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: After being discovered flirting with his boss' daughter, Sing gets blown up, but later gets relived as his professor transforms him to be a cyborg of household products.

programme.title: We are Family
programme.desc: "Rent-a-Family" offers relatives for rent and in the process, the trio rendering such services discover the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Chan plays Eddie Yang, a Hong Kong cop who is working with Interpol officer Arthur Watson in order to protect a gifted young child.

programme.title: Peg O' My Heart
programme.desc: Haunted by nightmares, night-shift taxi driver Choi meets psychiatrist Dr. Man. In therapy, Man begins to experience disturbing and perplexing dreams, blurring the line between reality and illusion.

programme.title: Cold War 2
programme.desc: Sean Lau, appointed as the Commissioner of Police after the success of the Cold War rescue operation, finds his reign rocked by the abduction of this wife and daughter.

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life
programme.desc: Sabrina's deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Eddie Peng charms as possibly the most handsome Monkey King alongside Shawn Yue & Ni Ni in this fantasy-action-adventure film.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad tempered and lives alone. He decides to end his life as he feels hopeless but is saved by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Three tales merges in this satire set against Hong Kong's housing crisis, where soaring property prices have driven people to desperate measures - including sharing a space with the dead!

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Ming's mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: MUMU
programme.desc: Mumu connects her deaf father to the outside world, but their peaceful life is disrupted when she must adapt and fit in to the hearing world, while her father is ensnared by a gang to commit crime.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: When a thrice-divorced entrepreneur falls for a poker dealer, who is also a cabaret dancer, they seem hopelessly mismatched - but will fate help them out?

programme.title: The Shadow's Edge
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves steals billions, outsmarting the 'Sky Eye' surveillance system. The Macau police enlist retired expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild the elite squad and hunt down the mastermind.

programme.title: Soul Mate
programme.desc: July and An Sheng's strong friendship is put to the test when they encounter a guy, Su Jia Ming, sparking a love triangle that alters both their destinies.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a visually impaired factory worker living in an island. After a hurricane cut them off from the outside world, a monster suddenly appears, turning whoever sees it into black shadows.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild China's team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: Call Of Heroes
programme.desc: Sean Lau, Louise Koo & Eddie Peng star in this action-packed story of a group of villagers who stand up to a cruel young warlord to protect their home.

programme.title: Welcome To My Side
programme.desc: After a breakup and an accident, Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks. It is only when he meets Jia Nan that her presence chases them away and sparks an absurd yet sweet romance.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A fortune teller predicts that Tung will be imprisoned for murder, he tries to change his fate but a veteran detective believes Tung to be a psychopathic serial killer & pursues him relentlessly.

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: Donnie Yen, Chow Yun Fat & Aaron Kwok star in this classic-inspired tale of the Monkey King's legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Fraudster Dai resurfaces in Paris after seven years on the run. The Chinese Fox Hunt Team is on a cross-border mission to recover stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the manhunt.

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit plots a major heist which is joined by two dispirited men inadvertently. Their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery lands them in a fierce police pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behavior and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. When he meets his teenage nephew who is ashamed of his stutter, the two develop a special friendship through mutual understanding.

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: Hong Kong's survival is at risk due to a radiation leak. A fire brigade is assigned to stop cesium fallout by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented disaster, can they save the city?

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: Kim is suffering from Alzheimer's disease but Ginger suspects that he is a film critic profiting from harsh reviews. Posing as a friend, Ginger gets closer to him and uncovers his secrets and sorrows.

programme.title: Welcome To My Side
programme.desc: After a breakup and an accident, Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks. It is only when he meets Jia Nan that her presence chases them away and sparks an absurd yet sweet romance.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: To make a living, Teddy accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. His career regains momentum after reunites with his long-lost daughter.

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wife's divorce request and his father's illness.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: Inspector Yan's daughter is found dead, and her classmate Wen is arrested. However, when another killing occurs after Wen's imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect that the true killer is still at large.

programme.title: I Want to Be Rich
programme.desc: Born into poverty, Wah goes astray but has a kind heart. After meeting and falling in love with a Vietnamese woman Mei, he decides to rebuild his life and finally achieves his dream of wealth.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: Ip Man fights some gangsters to protect a school, and is challenged by a Wing Chun master. He accepts the duel for his family and disciples and emerges victorious, securing the Grandmaster title.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty and their father's drug addiction. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.

programme.title: Someday or One Day
programme.desc: Adapted from a TV series, the movie follows Huang as she mourns for her boyfriend's death and receives a mysterious cassette player to travel back in time. Will she be able to change his destiny?

programme.title: The Monkey King 2
programme.desc: Monkey King escorts Monk Tang to retrieve the scriptures and face the White Bone Spirit, who preys on innocents for immortality. Monkey King will have to fight the White Bone Spirit to save Monk Tang!

programme.title: The Prosecutor
programme.desc: A young man is wrongly convicted of drug trafficking. A former cop turned prosecutor believes in his innocence and launches an investigation, risking his life and career to find the true perpetrator.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: Stephen Chow stars in this parody on the popular Judge Pao stories, depicting how he helps a rape victim fight the system against corrupt lawyers & officials.

programme.title: Come Back Home
programme.desc: De & family goes on a drive to Changbai Mountain, where their magical holiday turns tragic when their 8-year-old son goes missing. Will they be able to find him before the cold winter takes him?

programme.title: Don't Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao has amnesia & wakes up every day remembering nothing from the day before. He meets psychotherapist Xing Yue & they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Hit N Fun
programme.desc: Ad executive Lin uncovers her boyfriend's affair with a champion boxer and challenges her to a match. Under the former boxing legend's training, her quest for revenge evolves into self-discovery.

programme.title: Project Gutenberg
programme.desc: The HK police is hunting for a counterfeiting gang led by a mastermind known as Painter. They recruit artist Lee Man to help in their quest, but the real identity of Painter surprises everyone.

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood
programme.desc: Shu Zhen's life takes a downturn after giving birth. Exhausted by childcare, ignored by her husband and burdened by in-laws and work, she endures lonely nights. Will dawn bring her hope or despair?

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at risk of closing down due to funding, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match to save it.

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life
programme.desc: Sabrina's deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: First instalment of the new remake of The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, adapted from Jin Yong's novel, see Zhang Wu Ji embroiled in a dispute involving two legendary weapons.

programme.title: My Wife Is A Gambling Maestro
programme.desc: Gambling queen, Ying Ying who is a contender for the Asian God of Gamblers competition and rescued by Gerrard but suffering from amnesia, she decided recover in time to compete in the big event!

programme.title: The Goldfinger
programme.desc: Based on Hong Kong's biggest financial scandal of Ching Yat Yin, who rises from rags to become a billionaire. An ICAC investigator spends 15 years to uncover the truth behind his rapid rise in wealth.

programme.title: Burning Blood
programme.desc: A police betrayal has resulted in the death of a narcotics squad member during the arrest of a drug lord. As other team members uncover the truth, they are torn between loyalty and betrayal.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control.

programme.title: My First Of May
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife are devastated by their daughter's muscular dystrophy. Years later, the faint movement of her pinky finger gives them a small but powerful sign of hope.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba turns his mother's chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hu's caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: Our Crazy Adventures
programme.desc: Before graduation, five high school friends decide to do something unforgettable and take on a seemingly impossible challenge - winning a crucial basketball game that could change their lives.

programme.title: Shock Wave
programme.desc: Superstar Andy Lau stars as a bomb specialist set on capturing a wanted criminal called Blast in this action-drama. However, will he be able to do it in time when Blast threatens a massacre?

programme.title: Welcome To My Side
programme.desc: After a breakup and an accident, Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks. It is only when he meets Jia Nan that her presence chases them away and sparks an absurd yet sweet romance.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: Starring Donnie Yen, Nicholas Tse, an inspector discovers that the team of masked thugs who killed his co-workers are led by a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him.

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: A Hong Kong drama written & directed by Kearen Pang, former talent manager Mei Fung retired to take care of her husband & son, but decides to return to work to find her value in life.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Framed and forced to leave all he loves, a grocery clerk ultimately grows into one of Shanghai's most powerful mob bosses. Yet, can he leave the past behind?

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents unite after their children are abducted. Driven by grief and rage, they hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate to bring their children home alive.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: It is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community!

programme.title: Everything is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming must attend his father's funeral to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and her family, but ended up falling into their trap.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Zhou Ran falls prey to an online dating scam. Tracing the scammer's clues, she reaches a coastal town and encounters two young men. Uncovering their involvement, her revenge plot unfolds.

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: In this Golden Horse winner starring Gordon Lam, a retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian drug mule.

programme.title: Silent Code
programme.desc: Reporter Lan research news from across a popular BBS forum. Xiang, a forum founder, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas but being the subject of heated debate due to a leaked video.

programme.title: The White Storm 2 Drug Lords
programme.desc: In this epic action-thriller starring Andy Lau & Louis Koo, a bounty of USD $100 million awaits those who successfully capture the biggest drug dealer in Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Ex-Files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Yun and Fei, face challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, and Fei and his girlfriend opt for a 'marriage cooling-off period' to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: In this saga of two warring clans, Tsao Feng from the Flag of Iron betrays Lo, his master and teams up with the enemy. Unexpectedly, Lo returns for revenge.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Three single females and the men they fall for think things are simple and blissful until the lasses' parents enter into the picture.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Alongside the equally famous Lo Lieh, superstar David Chiang plays noble warrior monk Chih Shim, the monk who saved the Southern Shaolin Temple.

programme.title: Heads for Sale
programme.desc: Chiao Chiao stars in the popular tale of a decapitating swordswoman who will let nothing stand in her way when she falls in love with a bandit's son.

programme.title: Heads for Sale
programme.desc: Chiao Chiao stars in the popular tale of a decapitating swordswoman who will let nothing stand in her way when she falls in love with a bandit's son.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Two ingenious lovebirds come up with what they think is a fool proof plan to get their parents to allow them to wed. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: Legend of the Fox
programme.desc: This exciting tale of revenge features cameos from the director's three most popular 'Venoms,' Kuo Chue, Chiang Sheng and Lu Feng.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: A stunning snake goddess in human form seduces a young scholar before a Buddhist monk breaks up their union.

programme.title: The Kid With a Tattoo
programme.desc: Starring kung-fu comedienne Wang Yu on a mission of justice, this film is kicked into high gear by Yuen Hua, Yuan Pin and the villainous Wang Lung-wei.

programme.title: Inside the Forbidden City
programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers' quintessential 'Huangmei Opera' costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng.

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: The famed Ivy Ling Po plays a mysterious swordswoman, who teams up with the Roving Knight in a battle against a string of intimidating villains.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: This epic classic charts a romance between two teenage cousins, who pursue their relationship despite objections from their respective families.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: 17-year-old Wong Fei Hung is prompted to go and do battle to avenge a friend's death and protect his family honour.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: Director Anthony Chan joins award-winning social satirist Alfred Cheung Kin Ting in this delightful variation on the hugely successful British Carry On!

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei turns human combine harvester as she hacks a path through life, avenging the death of her family under the moniker 'The Jade Raksha'.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: This tragic tale depicts the life of Fang Pi Yu, a singer whose husband dies in his attempt to free her from her past, and whose father-in-law throws her out.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this sequel, the Mad Monk is joined by immortal scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin, as they both wreak havoc in an attempt to outdo each other!

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: Hsu Hsia, a great kung fu actor himself, both directs and leads a team of four martial arts choreographers in his hilarious tale of 'kung fu pickpockets.'

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: The court intrigues, politicking, bickering and backstabbing continues in this sequel to The Empress Dowager. Starring Lisa Lu.

programme.title: Come Drink With Me
programme.desc: King Hu's groundbreaking film set the foundation for all his action films that followed, most notably Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: A cruel uncle stands in the way between a young scholar and the beautiful gal with whom he falls in love, and happiness.

programme.title: The Master of Kung Fu
programme.desc: In this action-packed experimental piece, an all-too-human Huang Fei-hung battles a gangster's plan to frame him for robbery and murder.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: One of the most enjoyable musicals to grace the Hong Kong screen, this classic stars the husband-and-wife team of Peter Chen and Betty Loh.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: First a hero and then his daughter try to protect Ming Emperor Jianwen infant son from rebels headed by Tien Fung.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Serio-comic clashes of cultures ensue when a Mainland Chinese family try to make a go of it in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Two rebel Shaolin warriors embark on a deadly secret mission aimed at bringing down the Ching Dynasty. Starring Lo Meng, Chin Siu Ho.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaw's Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaire's daughter.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Michelle Mei Suet plays Szu-szu, a spoiled girl who leaves her beau Yang Fan, to go off in search of a swordsman whom she idolizes. Whom will she end up with?

programme.title: Song of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei exchanges her martial arts weaponry for a syringe in this exotic contemporary drama by Pan Lei.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The first make HK$1 million at the local box office, Chang Cheh's Wuxia film sparked a new age in martial arts films with its male anti-heroes and violence.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: Starring Kara Hui, Yuen Tak and Meng Yuen Man, this film depicts a series of battles as everyone fights over the 'Yuan Yang Swords', which hold the secrets to Kung Fu.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: Written and directed by Cheng Kang, this classic film starring Yueh Wah depicts how the Sung Dynasty army's chief instructor is framed by a corrupt minister.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: In Part 2 of this adventure, only the title weapons' union can save the 6 remaining sects which vie for mastery of the martial world.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Fans of 'The Little Mermaid' are in for a delightful surprise when they see this spectacular Chinese operatic adaptation, where a carp turns into a fairy.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: When a top boxer (Lau Kar Leung) refuses to obey an imperial eunuch, other martial arts experts are sent to hunt him down and kill him.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Martial arts star Jimmy Wang Yu plays Kwei Wu, who unites with his wife Kan to battle kidnappers at the Red Lotus Temple.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A motorcycle workshop owner feels compelled to damn the physical and legal consequences and go on racing.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Hsuan sets out to apprehend George Eaton, a high profile thug who has escaped to Hong Kong. With home support, can Yang take him down?

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: A man comes across a secret list of anti-Ching rebel names and quickly becomes a target for Ching loyalists.

programme.title: Forever and Ever
programme.desc: Huangmei Opera queen, Ivy Ling Po stars in this tale of a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter a girl who is dying.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: A Shaolin hero and the vicious Pai Mei lock horns in this kungfu revenge tale that spans two generations.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: Directed by Lee Han-hsiang and starring Michael Hui, this blockbuster confirms Hui's versatile talents as the king of comedy.

programme.title: Lady of the Law
programme.desc: One of director Shen Chiang's last works, this action-packed adventure features a lone female fighter, decades before the dawn of pro-feminist kung fu films.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: In this saga of warring clans, revenge and the ultimate martial arts skills, Yun, a young swordsman, battles the odds to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: In one of her first roles, 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon' villain Cheng Pei Pei plays a kung-fu Nancy Drew who must face a secret serial killer.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: This light-hearted 'a-go-go' romance depicts how three doctors pursue three beauties who play hard to get!

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: When deadbeats Ming and Liang stumble upon records of scandals involving government officials, what follows is a humorous misadventure of epic proportions.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: The peaceful life of Golden Swallow is shattered when her unrequited suitor, Silver Roc, begins a killing spree to draw her out of seclusion. Stars Cheng Pei Pei, Jimmy Wang Yu.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: An alluring female fairy seeks love among mortals and finds it in a man who takes care of an orphanage.

programme.title: Angel With the Iron Fists
programme.desc: After her father is killed by gangsters, a young woman seeks revenge plus bids to ensure that justice is served. Starring Lily Ho.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Director Lu Chun-ku leads Liu Yung, Liang Yun-hsin and 'Thundering Mantis,' Liang Chia-jen on a madcap quest filled with double crosses and triple plots.

programme.title: The Hidden Power of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: When defeated villain, Sung Ching-shu, restarts his reign of terror after mastering the yin and yang combination, only two swordsmen can stop him.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: Winner of Best Picture in the 12th Asian Film Festival, this Huangmei Opera epic stars Li Li Hua and Ivy Ling Po in a romance that stretches across the decades.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: Chiao Hsiung plays a bandit who steals from the rich and gives to the poor, all the while risking the threat of his evil nemesis, the evil bounty hunter Wang.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Lauded as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals of the 60s, this award-winning piece starring Linda Lin Dai as a dancer who finds romance with her boss's son.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: Trouble ensues after Ah To (Gordon Liu) marries a Japanese martial artist (Yuka Mizuno) and has a need to prove his martial prowess.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: Action king, David Chiang plays Wei Feng, who is sent to investigate the suspicious Tien family. However, he never expects to fall for the beautiful Chi.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: Directed by Chang cheh, this kung fu film is one of the final efforts in the 'Venoms'' genre. It features a main character who is mistaken for a clan leader.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: After a bride-to-be is discovered to be possessed, justice must be done and an exorcism performed before anyone can rest in peace.

programme.title: Torrent of Desire
programme.desc: Flames of lust burn strongly in this high-octane melodrama that stars Jenny Hu, Yang Fan and Qiao Zhuang.

programme.title: Perils of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: This well-named cliffhanger is fraught with adventure involving a mystery swordsman, a sensual swordswoman, an imperial assassin, a Ghost Mansion and more!

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: This gender-bending tale depicts the romance between a wealthy girl and a man disguised as a flunkey in order to be employed at her house.

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: Cheng Tien Chi plays a righteous priest with supernatural powers, who returns from the dead to wreak havoc against one of the corrupt kingdoms.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: 60s pop star Carrie Ku Mei plays pop star 'Little Lark' in her greatest role, in this romance that features some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: As a young clan member rises to helm the Dragon gang after his foster father's death, an incriminating letter changes everything. Can he fight the tide?

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Wong Yue and Gordon Liu star in this entertaining 'hopping vampire' action comedy.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: If you liked House of 72 Tenants, you won't want to miss out on this humorous, fun-filled sequel complete with 10 more tenants!

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This comedy contains dramatisations of some of the funniest and most surreal film gossips of director Li Han-Hsiang's 30 year career.

programme.title: Men From the Gutter
programme.desc: From its evocative title to its gritty filming and gutsy plot, this sizzling crime thriller strikes a chord with audience round the world.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.

programme.title: The Lady Is the Boss
programme.desc: A martial arts sifu and a hip marketing wiz have to overlook their differences to outsmart gangsters who are trying to take them down.

programme.title: The Sword and the Lute
programme.desc: Kwei Wu and his partner go on a mission to destroy the Phoenix Lute, a deadly weapon that shoots poisonous needles and can only be destroyed by the Kan sword.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Three single females and the men they fall for think things are simple and blissful until the lasses' parents enter into the picture.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: A woman sets up a troubled love triangle involving 2 swordsmen (Ti Lung and Lau Wing) and an enchanting lady (Ching Li).

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A young woman, who has gone through life disguised as a boy, must deal with her family's pressure for her to marry and the love of another woman.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: This actioner revolves around the conflicts of kung fu masters. Complications further ensue when one of them falls for a princess.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: A young rebel goes into legend after being reincarnated to save his people from their tyrannical emperor.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Alongside the equally famous Lo Lieh, superstar David Chiang plays noble warrior monk Chih Shim, the monk who saved the Southern Shaolin Temple.

programme.title: Usurpers of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: When Prince Li of the Sung Dynasty is exiled with his lovely wife and faithful warrior, Li Lan, he later commits suicide. Now, it is up to Li Lan to avenge him.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Chiang Li Ping plays a scorned wife, while Elaine Chin Yen Ling is the mistress who teaches the hypocritical husband that what goes around, comes around.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In this unofficial third sequel to The 36th Chamber of Shaolin, San Te (Gordon Liu) is given the task of training Fong Sai Yuk.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Catch superstar, Linda Lin Dai, in one of her most acclaimed roles in this story of forbidden love between a country maiden and the emperor.

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: The old and the new were mixed together to create a far-out period action love story.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: After a compulsive gambler's wife leaves him, he gets offered a beautiful ghost as his new wife.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A trio of heroes go up against a power-hungry Ming Dynasty official and also cross paths with three beauties.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: A stunning snake goddess in human form seduces a young scholar before a Buddhist monk breaks up their union.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: A wine shop owner's son, who finds a brilliant martial arts coach in his private tutor, foils a plan by a thief but what happens when he returns for revenge?

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays a beauty tricked into sacrificing herself for the good of the Chinese people. However, the truth is revealed too late.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a female doctor criticizes a fashion designer's creations, but love follows regardless.

programme.title: The Emperor and His Brother
programme.desc: This epic depicts how Chen Chia Lo and his men set out to persuade the Qing Emperor Chien Lung to acknowledge his Han bloodline and join the anti-Qing movement.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The film's curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: From writer director Pan Lei comes this Chinese variation of Henry King's famous 1950's film about a persecuted swordsman.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Based on the folk legend, director Li Han Hsiang presents this humorous portrayal of the Emperor Chien Lung's adventures in Jiang Nan.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The 'iron triangle' comprising director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung produces this explosive kung fu epic.

programme.title: Sweet and Wild
programme.desc: With a twisted plot, mistaken identities, along with some terrific musical numbers, this comedy of errors featuring Li Ching is absolutely fabulous.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: In one of her first roles, 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon' villain Cheng Pei Pei plays a kung-fu Nancy Drew who must face a secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this sequel, the Mad Monk is joined by immortal scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin, as they both wreak havoc in an attempt to outdo each other!

programme.title: Heads for Sale
programme.desc: Chiao Chiao stars in the popular tale of a decapitating swordswoman who will let nothing stand in her way when she falls in love with a bandit's son.
